decisions.reason: The overall graduated-orange direction does not replace or invalidate the strapline line and contrast options, which are independently established by the same message.
The colour decision does not change the task-local requirement to develop original initial concepts using reference material only as inspiration.
The graduated-orange direction does not alter the flame-based O or its recognition requirement; the symbol changes in the message are independently represented.
Changing the logo's colour treatment does not change the requirement for fresh, original artwork or the inspiration-only role of the AI-generated draft.
The colour direction does not alter the company name, exclusion of the word truck, or the required wider-business representation.
The graduated-orange treatment does not modify the independently specified letterform character and typeface requirements.
The colour treatment does not change the requirement to include the existing strapline.

The documentation deliverable remains to provide brand colour details; the source selects a visual treatment but does not change that deliverable's scope or specify documentation content requiring a state update.
The logo colour decision does not alter the separate deliverable for complementary brand font guidance.
